name: Realm: tidal coast and reefs (realistic)
description: Setting: a grounded, cinematic tidal coastline photographed on location like a feature-film still - wet rock, shingle, tidal flats and shallow reefs, timber harbours and whitewashed cottages, sea mist and soft reflected light, cool blue-green tones; any magic is a faint shimmer on the water
notes: The water homeland as a place: use it with the backgrounds in backgrounds/fantasy/country/water/ (set components.realm).
